image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of an orange agricultural disc harrow (often colloquially referred to as a plow) resting on gravelly soil. The implement features a heavy orange metal frame supporting two gangs of black, concave steel discs arranged in a V-configuration. A partial view of a vehicle tire is visible in the upper right background. There are digital timestamp artifacts ('2013 09') and gibberish text overlays on the image.
